analyst_view.overall: Ipswich (16th, 11 pts, three defeats in five, latest 2-0 at Tottenham) host Aston Villa (12th, 14 pts) on Saturday evening. Villa lost 1-0 in Istanbul to Galatasaray on Tuesday without a single shot on target, extending their winless run to six, and Unai Emery may rotate after the trip. Villa are without Onana, Ruggeri and probably Lindelof (illness), while Matty Cash is reported set to return from concussion; Ipswich's Leif Davis went off at Spurs with an ankle and calf knock and Gary O'Neil is hopeful he plays. The numbers count Davis and Cash as out, so both may be too pessimistic, but the two roughly cancel. Michael Salisbury referees, and his low card average is already in the numbers.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.2 goals, already taking about 10% off Ipswich for Leif Davis and adding about 6% to each side for the missing defenders (Davis, Cash). Football365 reports Cash set to return and O'Neil hopes Davis plays; if both play, Ipswich gain a creator and Villa regain their right-back, and the effects largely cancel. Villa's blunt attack (no shot on target in Istanbul) is already in their recent form, so I drop my earlier small lean and stay at 3.2.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.4 corners, already trimming Ipswich for winning only 16 in their last six. Davis is Ipswich's main overlapping full-back, so his return would help their wide play, but the numbers already assume him out and the club has not confirmed it either way. I stay at 9.4.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.1 cards, already raising Villa for their recent bookings and trimming about 8% for Michael Salisbury, who averages 3.6 cards a game. Villa picked up two more yellows in Istanbul (McGinn, Joao Gomes), but nothing about this match points beyond what the numbers count, so I stay at 4.1.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.3 shots. Villa travel back from Turkey with four days' rest and Emery rotates often (64% of his XI kept lately), which keeps legs fresh, while Ipswich have had a full week and tend to keep the same eleven. The two pull in opposite directions, so I stay at 25.3.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.7 shots on target, already lowering both sides for few shots on target lately. I had leaned slightly higher for Villa's missing defenders, but Onana, Ruggeri and Cash are now in the numbers, and Cash may even be back, so I stay at 8.7.
